selection_metric: mean end-to-end power across the three development effect cells, subject to the unchanged q=0.10 gate and admission floor h=10

selected_design.name: campaign75-fixed-daily
selected_design.declared_campaign_cap: M equals the proposal cap fixed before the first proposal
selected_design.spending_rule: gamma_j = 0.75/M + 0.25/[j(j+1)] for j <= M; gamma_j = 0.25/[j(j+1)] for j > M

rejected_designs: proposal-time mixtures over 0.25, 0.50, and 1.00 times the fixed bet
validation_seed_policy: the pre-existing dense matched_seed_blocks map rooted at 314159 and 20260730, with 250 replications in each of 22 cells
public_replay_policy: unchanged telescoping weights and five-day inspection; the campaign design is prospective and is not retrofitted to the observed market replay
